name: ClickDetector
description: Counts consecutive taps inside a time and distance window for double/triple-click gestures.
notes: `ClickDetectorState` was public with public mutable `count`/`lastClick` fields; the new state class is private.
Timing uses a Stopwatch (the VM's monotonic clock) instead of DateTime.now() (wall clock).
A tap further than kDoubleTapSlop from the previous one restarts the sequence.
preview.dart imports the `button` component; preview files are excluded from dependency checking.
